title: Strength Athlete’s Arm Day 🐗
author: Ralph_Suggett_312243
desc: Programme for strength athletes particularly strongmen who need more arm training that is easy to recover from, allowing prioritisation of main lifts. Arm training can improve performance in events such as circus dumbbell, Conan’s wheel or grip events and can help reduce the risk of bicep tears common in the sport. For powerlifters, it can reduce the risk of a bicep tear when using a mixed grip on the deadlift and can help mitigate the risk of dropping a deadlift.

ex.note: Treat these like an active warmup. Use a light weight and change from a neutral position to a supinated position on the way up. Short rest time.
Use fat grips or wrap a towel around the bar if you have no axle bar. Go heavy, but leave a rep in the tank. Make sure the curls are strict and drop the weight between sets if required.

ss.note: Go for the pump here. Light weight, 15-20 reps full ROM. Use EZ curl bar.
Some swinging is fine on these as long as eccentric is controlled.
